collect.comment: US-048 mobile budgets (manual §2): run as `lhci autorun --config=.lighthouserc.mobile.json`. Lighthouse's DEFAULT form factor is mobile (Moto-G-class CPU + slow-4G throttling), so no `preset` is set. Same two single-page routes, auto-discovered from dist/.

assertMatrix.comment: Mobile (with tier fallback): Performance >= 80 and LCP < 4 s (manual §2). Accessibility >= 95 holds on mobile too. On mobile the device-tier probe drops DOF + volumetric clouds and gentles the scroll-velocity coupling (US-048), and reduced-motion users get the static poster with no engine at all.
